newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BORDEAUX STRIKER HISTILLOLES SIGNS FOR METZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BORDEAUX STRIKER HISTILLOLES SIGNS FOR METZ.

text.p: Bordeaux striker Franck Histilloles, sidelined through injury since the beginning of the season, said on Tuesday he had signed a three-year contract with fellow French first division side Metz.
"I have decided to join Metz because I know that if Bordeaux secure a European berth next year they would recruit new talent and I would stay on the bench," Histilolles said.
A former under-21 international, Histillolles, 24, broke his right leg on the eve of the UEFA Cup quarter-final against AC Milan last March. He has not played for the first team since then.
